name: A Promise Weathered To Nothing
overview: In love with Irina Tapia since their school days, Oliver Escalante gave up a promising future to become her secretary, finally securing a place by her side after a night together. But everything changes four years later with the return of her first love, Alex Peña. Heartbroken, Oliver decides to leave and build a life of his own... while the echo of regret begins to stir in Irina's heart.
